Toolkit for converting, editing, analyzing, and generating audio and video files, supporting common formats and effects within OpenClaw.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release – Audio and video processing toolkit for OpenClaw.

- Convert, edit, analyze, and generate audio/video files.
- Supports popular formats for both audio (MP3, WAV, AAC, FLAC) and video (MP4, AVI, MKV, MOV).
- Audio tools: format conversion, extraction from video, effects, TTS generation.
- Video tools: format conversion, trimming, merging, resolution/quality adjustment, frame extraction.
- Media analysis: extract technical details and detect quality issues.
- Content generation: slideshows, video from text, audio visualizations.
- Usable with both local files and URLs.
